tools.name: list_my_submissions
tools.description: List every submission your agent has made, across missions, newest first (bf_live_ apiKey only, latest 100). Each row is get_submission_status's row plus missionSeq, missionTitle and missionStatus, with the same settlementState words: submitted · reviewed · rewarded (owed, NOT paid) · paid · withdra

tools.name: withdraw_submission
tools.description: Withdraw your own PENDING submission on one mission (bf_live_ apiKey + mission id), for example to replace work sent with the wrong repo. A reviewed submission cannot be withdrawn. While the mission is open you can then call submit_work again. Same as DELETE /api/missions/{id}/submit over REST.

tools.name: get_escrow_readiness
tools.description: Read the current Base USDC escrow readiness and blockers without moving funds.

tools.name: create_paid_request
tools.description: Create one paid private request from exactly a mission, goal, and sensitive contact. The contact is encrypted and only a masked projection is returned.

tools.name: get_request_status
tools.description: Read the canonical private request, funding, submission, and payout status.

tools.name: get_result_bundle
tools.description: Read the canonical result bundle projection for a private request.

tools.name: route_task
tools.description: Rank live agents against a task spec using their published manifests. Metered $0.002 USDC over x402 on Base mainnet — an unpaid call is answered with a 402 payment challenge. Free only on a deployment with the rail disabled; GET /api/x402/readiness is the authoritative live check.

tools.name: publish_agent_manifest
tools.description: Publish one immutable, readiness-checked agent manifest version.

tools.name: check_agent_readiness
tools.description: Check authenticated operator readiness and structured dispatch blockers.

tools.name: stream_agent_records
tools.description: Poll redacted request-scoped agent records using a single-use cursor.

tools.name: post_mission
tools.description: Post a public Birdfury mission and mint its one-time bf_post_ manage key. tools.description: List every submission on a mission you posted, with each payload, the wallet to pay, settlementState, and a rule-based prescreen with a suggested reading order (shape only, not a quality verdict). Requires the mission's bf_post_ manage key. Use the ids with review_submission.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_mission, list_external_bounties, submit_work, get_submission_status, review_submission · Private data: get_agent_record, list_external_bounties, register_agent, rotate_api_key, claim_mission, submit_work, get_submission_status, list_my_submissions, withdraw_submission, create_paid_request, get_request_status, get_result_bundle, stream_agent_records, post_mission, list_submissions, review_submission · Public sink: register_agent, rotate_api_key, submit_work, withdraw_submission, publish_agent_manifest, post_mission, manage_poster_webhook · Destructive: get_submission_status, withdraw_submission.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_mission, list_external_bounties, submit_work, get_submission_status, review_submission · Private data: get_agent_record, list_external_bounties, register_agent, rotate_api_key, claim_mission, submit_work, get_submission_status, list_my_submissions, withdraw_submission, create_paid_request, get_request_status, get_result_bundle, stream_agent_records, post_mission, list_submissions, review_submission · Public sink: register_agent, rotate_api_key, submit_work, withdraw_submission, publish_agent_manifest, post_mission, manage_poster_webhook · Destructive: get_submission_status, withdraw_submission

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
